title: Spanish, Minor (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: 18cr total, exact bulletin match. Core Requirements (9cr) is 'SPAN 200 or 301 (3cr); SPAN 215 or 253W (3cr); SPAN 100/100A/100B/100C (3cr)' -- SPAN 301, SPAN 215, and SPAN 100C aren't in the current span_catalog.json (only SPAN 100/100A/100B, SPAN 200, and SPAN 253W are), so the catalog-present alternate of each either/or pair was used: SPAN 100, SPAN 200, SPAN 253W. Supporting Courses (3cr, select from a list) filled with SPAN 220. Advanced Electives (6cr, select from a list) filled with SPAN 410 + SPAN 412. All six courses are prereq-free in the current catalog. Bulletin note: heritage/native speakers take SPAN 100A/301 instead and may not take SPAN 410 -- a track-specific substitution not modeled here, same as other language minors in this catalog picking one standard track.
